facts.claim: Claude Opus 5.5 painted "Stoneware Jug with Two Lemons and a Knife" stroke by stroke in a 69-minute session - every brushstroke written as code and executed by an oil-paint simulation. "No image generator."

"Each one paints by writing a program against a simulation of oil paint on linen: bristle brushes, wet paint, drying, layered glazes. No image model is involved." 75 paintings by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Moonshot, DeepSeek and others; most painters "never see a picture of his work."

Anthropic's Jake Eaton: Opus 5.5's paintings are "a python program generated pixel by pixel. there is no image model, and no off-the-shelf art software" - about 7,500 lines of code, no reference pictures.
GPT-6 Astra drew Federico Viticci's portrait in Apple Notes on his Mac - the note's timestamps run from 12:39 AM to 1:38 AM (about an hour of drawing).
Adobe's principal evangelist Kris Kashtanova: "Told GPT-6 Astra to draw me in @Photoshop. I'm mind blown 🤯 it just did it based on my photo."
GPT-6 Astra, given "a robot, a paint brush, and a camera", taught itself to paint the Golden Gate Bridge on real paper, improving attempt by attempt - 4.97 million views; Sam Altman: "i want one!"
facts.source: thijs on X; Sam Altman on X

facts.claim: "GPT-6 Astra built this Manhattan world in Unreal Engine over the course of a week. It was literally able to go street by street to make each one perfect." (uses existing assets incl. MetaHumans, per Shumer's review)
From an old drawing, GPT-6 Astra "crafted 3,295 fully editable detailed objects" of a steam train in Blender "after few minutes" (creator-reported).
Same person, same request, 56 days apart: July 11 "Sol" made a toy-like bat in Blender; September 5 GPT-6 Astra made a photorealistic one and "just kept going until I ran out of tokens."
"I spent 1.6 billion tokens building a full game with GPT-6 ASTRA. Not a demo. A FINISHED, playable game." - PaperRoute is live at paperroute.lol.
BenchCAD (CAD reconstruction): GPT-6 Astra 95.9% vs Claude Fable 5.1 84.3% vs GPT-5.6 Sol 83.3% - vendor-reported by OpenAI; Claude runs used modified settings.
Epic added an MCP server to Unreal Engine 5.8 (released June 2026) so external AI agents such as Claude Code and Cursor can drive the editor - spawn actors, set lighting, build materials, run tests.

"Vibe hardware is here. I gave Astra my credit card and asked for a Teenage Engineering-style mini DJ controller. It ... sourced parts, read Chinese datasheets, built a CAD model, ordered everything..."
"A screen recording of the drawing process used to be the strongest evidence an artist could offer." Computer-use agents now leave genuine stroke-by-stroke histories.
"OpenAI showed models that Astra had made of a house, a circuit board, a video game world, and a car transmission."
